settings.title: Settings

sync.title: Sync & backup
sync.offHint: Your cards and boards live on this device only — nothing is stored on our server, and no account exists for you.
sync.onHint: Your cards and boards are mirrored to the server, so you can pick them up on another device and restore them if you lose this one.
sync.writeDown: Write down your recovery passphrase below — it is the only way to reach this backup from another device.
sync.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
sync.deleted: Server data deleted. This device keeps its own copy.
sync.deleteHint: Erases everything stored on the server for you and switches sync off. Your device keeps its own copy.

settings.identityHint: Write this down. It's the only way to recover your library on another device.
settings.autoScrollHint: Scrolls the chat so the currently-spoken verse stays in view.
settings.announceVerseNumber: Announce verse number before each verse
settings.autoPlay: Auto-play next passage when playback ends
settings.autoPlayHint: Continues into the next passage — the next chapter, the next ~5 verses, or the next entry of the reading list you are in — and reads on until you stop.
